They come, no matter what. Sometimes it even works. But this... You... all that you've been gathering. The strength of spirit.|Healer taking to Cassian Andor had healing his blaster wound|}} A [[human]] '''Force healer''' provided [[Force healing]] services to members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Yavin 4]] in [[2 BBY]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|I sense the weight of things, things I can't see. Pain, fear... need. Most beings carry the things that shaped them. They carry the past. But some... very few... your pilot... They're gathering as they go. There's a purpose to it. He's a messenger.|Healer taking to Bix Caleen about Cassian Andor|}} In [[2 BBY]], a [[Gender|female]] [[human]] provided [[Force healing]] as well as emotional support to members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. While on Yavin, her abilities only worked occasionally, but individuals would continue to come to her regardless. Eventually, [[Bix Caleen]] brought [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] to see the healer about a [[blaster]] wound on Andor's shoulder that was not healing. Despite his distrust in Force healers, Andor allowed the healer to gently touch his shoulder while she closed her eyes. As she healed Andor's wound, she was able to sense the strength and purpose of Andor's spirit, which gave her clarity and restored her faith in the process. Confused by her response, Andor left, but Caleen stayed to ask her what she saw in him. The healer described what she felt in Andor, eventually saying that there was a purpose for Andor, describing him as a messenger. When Caleen returned home, she discovered that Andor's arm was doing better. She proceeded to tell him about her conversation with the healer, calling him a messenger. In [[1 BBY]], as Andor prepared to depart on a [[mission to the Ring of Kafrene]], the Force healer was unloading supplies when she made eye-contact with Andor. The man whose importance she had felt the previous year nodded at her as he walked towards his [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|ship]].{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Thank you.''"
"''Thank you for what?''"
"''The clarity. That feeling. it's been a very long time. I thought it had gone for good. It's so easy to lose faith.|Healer taking to Cassian Andor had healing his blaster wound|}} The healer was a [[Force-sensitive]] female human with light skin and [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s. While at the Yavin base she had short greying [[hair]]. She had a strong belief in [[the Force]] and used her abilities to provide healing to others. ==Equipment== She wore a red and brown [[robe]] when she worked as a healer on Yavin 4. ==Behind the scenes== The Force healer was portrayed by [[Josie Walker]] and first appeared in [[Messenger|seventh episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} Writer [[Dan Gilroy]] expressed that, after meeting with the Force healer, Cassian Andor became a believer in the Force.{{Apple|subdomain=podcasts|url=gb/podcast/andor-with-dan-gilroy/id1518622561?i=1000723472632|text=Andor with Dan Gilroy by Script Apart with Al Horner|date=2025-08-25|archivedate=20250828204206}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Messenger}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} ==Sources== *{{Databank|force-healer|Force healer}} *{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი ძალით მკურნალი }} [[Category:Alliance to Restore the Republic members]] [[Category:Force-sensitives]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Females]]
